subject: Media Literacy
title: Dark Patterns in Ads
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Dark Patterns in Ads.

hook.text: The 'X' to close the ad is tiny and gray. The 'Install Now' button is huge and green. That's not an accident.

buildup.text: Dark patterns are design tricks that manipulate users into actions they didn't intend, like clicking ads.

discovery.text: Common dark patterns include hidden costs, trick questions, forced continuity, and disguised ads.

twist.text: Companies test thousands of design variations to find the one that tricks the most people.

climax.text: If an interface feels confusing, it might be designed that way to profit from your confusion.

punchline.text: Bad design is often good manipulation.

quiz.question: What are dark patterns?
options: Design tricks that manipulate users into unintended actions
